# CrowAgent

> CrowAgent is a UK compliance-intelligence platform for small and mid-sized suppliers. Its flagship product is CrowMark, a public-sector bid and tender management suite that finds live tenders on Contracts Finder and Find a Tender, drafts answers grounded in the supplier's own submitted bids with deterministic figure-checking and PPN 017 AI disclosure, scores social value against the PPN 002 model, and evidences delivery under the Procurement Act 2023. Alongside CrowMark, CrowAgent offers CrowCash (late-payment recovery), CrowCyber (Cyber Essentials), CrowESG (VSME reporting), and a free CSRD scope checker. The pages below are plain, statute-cited explainers and free tools written for UK procurement, cyber, and sustainability compliance.

## Products

- [CrowMark](https://crowagent.ai/crowmark): Flagship UK bid and tender suite. Daily tender discovery, grounded answer drafting, bid-fit and coverage marking, compliance matrix, e-sourcing, Pink/Red/Gold reviews, PPN 002 social value, and post-award delivery evidence. From £49/month.
- [CrowCash](https://crowagent.ai/crowcash): Recovers overdue B2B invoices by applying the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998 to the ledger, Bank of England base plus 8% interest and fixed compensation per invoice.
- [CrowCyber](https://crowagent.ai/crowcyber): Cyber Essentials certification co-pilot for UK SMEs, covering the five NCSC controls, 66 questions, an evidence library, and PPN 014/21 readiness.
- [CrowESG](https://crowagent.ai/crowesg): VSME ESG reporting for UK SMEs with a deterministic carbon footprint on DESNZ 2025 factors, SECR report, double materiality, and buyer questionnaires.
- [CSRD checker](https://crowagent.ai/tools/csrd-applicability-checker): Free CSRD applicability checker against the Omnibus I headline figures.
- [Products overview](https://crowagent.ai/products/): Summary of the full CrowAgent product portfolio.

## Free tools

- [Tools hub](https://crowagent.ai/tools): Free, statute-cited compliance checks for UK teams. No account required.
- [PPN 002 social value calculator](https://crowagent.ai/tools/ppn-002-calculator): Score a UK public-sector bid against the mandatory 10% social-value floor, cited to National TOMs and Oxford SVB proxies.
- [Cyber Essentials readiness](https://crowagent.ai/tools/cyber-essentials-readiness): Five-control self-test against Cyber Essentials v3.3 (Danzell, in force 27 April 2026).
- [Late payment calculator](https://crowagent.ai/tools/late-payment-calculator): Statutory interest at Bank of England base plus 8% and fixed compensation on overdue B2B invoices under the Late Payment Act 1998.
- [CSRD applicability checker](https://crowagent.ai/tools/csrd-applicability-checker): Check a group against the CSRD Omnibus I headline figures.
- [VSME materiality light](https://crowagent.ai/tools/vsme-materiality-light): Three-question VSME materiality screen for non-listed UK SMEs, cited to EFRAG VSME 2024.
- [PPN 002 calculator methodology](https://crowagent.ai/tools/ppn-002-calculator/methodology): How the PPN 002 social-value score is computed.
- [Late payment methodology](https://crowagent.ai/tools/late-payment-calculator/methodology): How statutory interest and compensation are calculated.

## Regulatory guides

- [PPN 002 social value: complete guide](https://crowagent.ai/blog/ppn-002-social-value-guide): What PPN 002 requires, the five themes, and how buyers score social value with National TOMs at a 10% minimum weighting.
- [The Procurement Act 2023 for SME bidders](https://crowagent.ai/blog/procurement-act-2023-sme-guide): What changed from 24 Feb 2025: MAT replaces MEAT, the Central Digital Platform and Find a Tender, s.52 KPIs on contracts over £5m, and what it means day-to-day for SMEs.
- [How to find and win your first UK public sector contract](https://crowagent.ai/blog/find-first-public-sector-contract): Where to look (Find a Tender vs Contracts Finder), how to read a tender, SQ vs ITT, the bid/no-bid decision, and PPN 002 social value.
- [Cyber Essentials v3.3 (Danzell)](https://crowagent.ai/blog/cyber-essentials-v3-3-danzell-2026): What changed in the version in force from 27 April 2026.
- [PPN 014/21 explained](https://crowagent.ai/blog/ppn-014-cyber-essentials-guide): Cyber Essentials as a procurement baseline for UK public-sector suppliers.
- [MFA mandatory from April 2026](https://crowagent.ai/blog/mfa-mandatory-2026): Why multi-factor authentication became mandatory under Cyber Essentials v3.3.
- [CSRD and Omnibus I](https://crowagent.ai/blog/csrd-omnibus-i-2026): How the Omnibus I directive narrowed CSRD scope in 2026.
- [UK and EU sustainability regulation in 2026](https://crowagent.ai/blog/regulatory-updates-2026): Key sustainability-regulation changes for the year.
- [Blog index](https://crowagent.ai/blog/): All CrowAgent regulatory guides and updates.

## Comparisons

- [Compare CrowMark](https://crowagent.ai/compare): Honest, sourced head-to-heads of CrowMark against the UK bid tools suppliers shortlist, with published pricing and a dated source for every competitor figure.
- [CrowMark vs AutogenAI](https://crowagent.ai/compare/crowmark-vs-autogenai): SME bid suite with published pricing from £49/month against an enterprise engine that quotes on request.
- [CrowMark vs mytender.io](https://crowagent.ai/compare/crowmark-vs-mytender-io): Figure-grounding and published pricing against a UK private-cloud drafting platform.
- [CrowMark vs CleanTender](https://crowagent.ai/compare/crowmark-vs-cleantender): Sector-agnostic bid suite against a soft facilities-management specialist; both publish pricing.
- [CrowMark vs SwiftBid](https://crowagent.ai/compare/crowmark-vs-swiftbid): Subscription suite from £49/month against a per-bid AI writing service, with the break-even worked through.
- [Social Value Portal vs CrowMark](https://crowagent.ai/blog/social-value-portal-vs-crowmark): How CrowMark compares to the Social Value Portal for UK suppliers.
